title: Meetup Sep 24
description:
🎉 Thrilled to have been a part of organizing such a massive event!
It was an incredible success with over 250+ participants joining us at the Seattle Data, AI, and Security Event at Microsoft Reactor, Redmond.
The event was packed with insightful sessions, and it was amazing to witness the enthusiasm and engagement from everyone. 🙌

title: RAG Workshop for FAU students
description:
Conducted 2 sessions on different RAG models. 
1. Q&A with PDF using RAG
2. Chat with PDF chat memory

title: Women in Tech
description: 🌟 The "Women in Tech" event on October 23rd, 2024 was a remarkable gathering of 300+ attendees, each bringing contagious energy and enthusiasm. The room was alive with shared purpose, camaraderie, and a passion for growth and empowerment—truly reflecting the strength of this community.

title: Climate Change Meetup
description:
We are thrilled to share the resounding success of our Innovations in Climate Engineering, AI Development & Fintech event! 🌟
A heartfelt THANK YOU to everyone who made this event a reality:
💡 Our Speakers:
Chaochao Zuo, CFA for sharing groundbreaking insights on AI-driven solutions.
Vibha R. Rathi for her visionary talk on the future of climate engineering.

title: Networking Mixer
description: We are happy to make our last in-person meetup of the year so wonderful🤩. The Networking Mixer we conducted on 10 Dec was solely for networking for our community where attendees met like-minded people, potential employers, and employees, and few found their mentors as well.

title: Our First Hackathon
description: A powerful weekend of innovation, collaboration, and community at the Seattle Data AI Hackathon—proud to be part of something truly impactful! 🚀

title: Microsoft Fabric Tour – Seattle’s Flagship Data & AI Event
description: The Microsoft Fabric Tour at Microsoft Reactor, Redmond gathered 400+ tech leaders for a high-energy day of innovation, featuring Arun Ulag’s keynote and deep dives into Microsoft Fabric, Copilot, and real-time intelligence. A true celebration of AI, community, and collaboration.

title: Building the Future with Weaviate's CEO, Bob van Luijt
description: Explore the future of AI-native development with Bob van Luijt, CEO of Weaviate, as he shares insights on building scalable GenAI solutions through open-source innovation. A must-attend for developers shaping the next wave of AI.

title: From Big Tech to Bold AI – Aiswarya Sankar on Building Entelligence.AI
description: Hear Aiswarya Sankar, Co-founder & CEO of Entelligence.AI, share her journey from Uber and Google to launching AI tools that transform engineering workflows. Gain insights into how her startup is redefining productivity through intelligent automation.

title: Reflecting on Humanity in AI at Seattle's Data Meetup
description: At the Seattle Data AI & Security July Meetup, the discussions led by speakers like Karthik Ravindran emphasized the importance of AI as a supportive tool guided by ethical human leadership. The focus on responsible AI in multi-cloud and spatial contexts inspired me to continue advocating for a zero-cost community platform for learning and growth.

title: Exploring AI's Future: Insights from Bellevue's 'AI Unleashed' Event
description: At the "AI Unleashed" event in Bellevue, attendees learned about AI's future through talks on digital twins, data quality, and human-centered tech. A panel discussion emphasized these themes, highlighting AI's active role in our community. Thanks to the speakers and volunteers for a successful event.
